Online and in-person bodybuilding coaching with individual training programs, nutrition guidance and weekly check-ins. Build muscle, lose fat and train with structure.
Hi Hajaro, I would like to know more about your coaching.
I reply to every message within two working days.
Do I need experience to start?
No. Plenty of people start without ever having touched a barbell. We start where you are, and your plan grows with you.
Most people do well with 2 to 4 sessions a week. We decide together, based on your goal and your schedule.
What is the difference between personal training and online coaching?
With personal training, I'm next to you in the gym. With online coaching, you train on your own and I guide you with a plan in your client dashboard, a weekly check-in and feedback on your videos.
Do I need a gym membership?
Most programs are made for a regular gym, but training at home is possible too. Tell me what equipment you have and I'll build the plan around it.
How quickly will I see results?

That depends on where you start, how consistently you train and eat, how well you sleep, and your body. Most people notice they're getting stronger before they see a change in the mirror. No honest coach can promise a specific result or date.
Do you help with food and diet?

Yes, with practical guidance that fits your training: calorie and macro targets and a simple meal structure. Detailed meal plans are part of the Premium and Contest Prep packages. For a medical diet, please see a dietitian.
Monthly packages can be cancelled before the next billing date. If a package has a minimum term, it's stated on the pricing page and in the terms of service.
Can I train with you if I have an injury?
Tell me about it first. I can adapt exercises, but I'm not a doctor or physiotherapist. If needed, I'll ask you to get a green light from your doctor before we start.
No. Training, food, sleep and consistency do the work. A few well-researched supplements, like creatine monohydrate, can help a little. I'm happy to explain what the research says.

Protein, carbohydrates and fat each do a different job. Total calories decide whether your weight changes; macros shape your body composition and performance.
Protein: 4 kcal per gram. Builds and repairs muscle.
Carbohydrates: 4 kcal per gram. The main fuel for hard training.
Fat: 9 kcal per gram. Needed for hormones and for absorbing fat-soluble vitamins.
The most important macronutrient for people who lift. Most people do well with 1.6 to 2.2 g per kg of body weight.

How collects, uses and protects personal data, and your rights under the GDPR.
("we", "us") respects your privacy. This policy explains which personal data we process, why, and the rights you have under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
Enquiry data: your name, email address, optional phone number, training goals, experience and message when you contact us.

Client data: profile details, training logs, body measurements, progress photos, check-ins and nutrition targets if you become a coaching client. Some of this (for example health information you choose to share) may be special-category data, which we process only with your explicit consent.
Technical data: the information needed to deliver the website securely. Analytics are only switched on with your consent.
Why we use your data and on what legal basis
To answer enquiries and provide coaching (contract, or steps before a contract).
To process health information needed for safe coaching (explicit consent).
To meet legal and accounting obligations (legal obligation).
To improve the website with anonymised statistics (consent).
When you send the contact form, your message is delivered to us by email through our email provider. It is not stored on the website itself.
The website stores one functional cookie ("lang") when you choose a language, so the site opens in that language next time. It contains only the language code.
Analytics cookies are only placed after you accept them in the cookie banner. You can change your choice at any time by clearing the site's cookies.
Fonts are served from this website itself, so no data is sent to font providers.
Progress photos are private to you and your coach. We only publish a result, photo or testimonial with your separate, written consent, which you can withdraw at any time. We then remove it quickly.
Enquiries that do not lead to coaching are deleted within 12 months. Client records are kept for the duration of coaching and afterwards for as long as the law requires.
We never sell your data. We work with carefully chosen processors (such as hosting and email providers) under data-processing agreements, and only as far as needed to provide our services.

You have the right to access, correct, delete, restrict or object to the processing of your data, the right to data portability and the right to withdraw consent at any time. You can also file a complaint with your national data protection authority (in the Netherlands: the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens).
To use your rights, email . Clients can also request a data export or account deletion from their dashboard profile.
Data is sent over encrypted connections (HTTPS). Access to client data is limited by role, and each client can only see their own information.
